items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Yeah, he was playing there too.

ctx.x: Was Ernest Rogers the drummer with you in those days?

Yeah, he was playing there too. I think I worked there four years and Lewis worked there nine years. Yeah, he was. Well, I remember when Walter was there. Mm-hmm. And I taken the job and I stood there until they all left. After Landry left and Big Eye Lewis left, he was running the job, Big Eye Lewis. But after Landry left, well that made us go to another job but didn't last long. We just quit that job and went to another one and it didn't last long.
